```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown

ROOT = Path.cwd()
while not (ROOT / "_quarto.yml").exists():
    ROOT = ROOT.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import chart_style as cs

d = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "data/processed/core_daily.csv", parse_dates=["date"]).set_index("date")
m = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "data/processed/core_monthly.csv")
m["month"] = pd.to_datetime(m["month"])
m = m.set_index("month")
events = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "data/events.csv")

d = d[d["hours_with_price"] >= 20]            # skip days with too few published hours
VOL_FROM = pd.Timestamp("2017-12-01")           # GÖP and bilateral volumes are published from here
for df in (d, m):
    df.loc[df.index < VOL_FROM, ["gop_mwh", "bilateral_mwh"]] = float("nan")
last = d.index.max()
fmt = lambda v, dec=0: "–" if pd.isna(v) else f"{v:,.{dec}f}"
```

```{python}
#| label: tiles
def window(days, end=last):
    return d.loc[end - pd.Timedelta(days=days - 1): end]

w30 = window(30)
w30_ly = window(30, last - pd.DateOffset(years=1))
ytd = d.loc[f"{last.year}-01-01": last]
chg = (w30["ptf_eur_mean"].mean() / w30_ly["ptf_eur_mean"].mean() - 1) * 100

tiles = [
    (f"PTF on {last:%d %b %Y}", f"{fmt(d.loc[last, 'ptf_mean'])} TL/MWh",
     f"{fmt(d.loc[last, 'ptf_eur_mean'], 1)} EUR/MWh · SMF {fmt(d.loc[last, 'smf_mean'])} TL/MWh"),
    ("PTF, last 30 days", f"{fmt(w30['ptf_mean'].mean())} TL/MWh",
     f"{fmt(w30['ptf_eur_mean'].mean(), 1)} EUR/MWh · {chg:+.0f}% in EUR vs a year earlier".replace("-", "−")),
    (f"PTF, {last.year} so far", f"{fmt(ytd['ptf_mean'].mean())} TL/MWh",
     f"{fmt(ytd['ptf_eur_mean'].mean(), 1)} EUR/MWh · simple average of daily means"),
]
HTML('<div class="tile-grid">' + "".join(
    f'<div class="tile"><p class="eyebrow">{a}</p><h3>{b}</h3><p>{c}</p></div>' for a, b, c in tiles) + "</div>")
```

## Daily, weekly and monthly prices

PTF is the hourly price set in the day-ahead market (GÖP). AOF is the volume-weighted average price of trades in the intraday market (GİP), from July 2015. SMF is the price of the last balancing instruction the system operator used in each hour (DGP). All three are averages of hourly prices in Turkish lira. Use the buttons to change the time step and the range; click a name in the legend to hide or show a line.

```{python}
#| label: price-chart
import plotly.graph_objects as go

cols3 = ["ptf_mean", "smf_mean", "aof_mean"]
weekly = d[cols3].resample("W-MON", label="left", closed="left").mean()
monthly = m[cols3]
views = {"Daily": d[cols3], "Weekly": weekly, "Monthly": monthly}

fig = cs.figure(None, "TL/MWh", height=460)
for i, (name, df) in enumerate(views.items()):
    for key, col in (("ptf", "ptf_mean"), ("smf", "smf_mean"), ("aof", "aof_mean")):
        cs.add_line(fig, df.index, df[col], "prices", key, unit=" TL/MWh", end_label=False)
        fig.data[-1].update(visible=(name == "Weekly"), legendgroup=key, showlegend=(name == "Weekly"))

n = len(fig.data)
buttons = []
for i, name in enumerate(views):
    vis = [j // 3 == i for j in range(n)]
    buttons.append(dict(label=name, method="update", args=[{"visible": vis, "showlegend": vis}]))
fig.update_layout(
    updatemenus=[dict(type="buttons", direction="right", buttons=buttons, active=1, x=0, y=1.04,
                      xanchor="left", yanchor="bottom", showactive=True, pad=dict(r=6, t=0),
                      font=dict(size=12))],
    margin=dict(t=40),
)
fig.update_xaxes(
    range=[last - pd.DateOffset(years=2), last],
    rangeselector=dict(buttons=[dict(count=3, label="3M", step="month", stepmode="backward"),
                                dict(count=1, label="1Y", step="year", stepmode="backward"),
                                dict(count=5, label="5Y", step="year", stepmode="backward"),
                                dict(step="all", label="All")],
                       x=1, xanchor="right", y=1.04, yanchor="bottom", font=dict(size=12)),
)
cs.add_events(fig, events, "ptf")
cs.style_controls(fig)
cs.show(fig)
```

## The long view in euros

Lira prices rose more than twentyfold between 2011 and 2026, mostly because of inflation and the weaker lira, so a long lira series hides real changes. EPİAŞ also publishes every hourly PTF in euros and US dollars, converted at that day's exchange rate. The chart shows weekly averages in either currency. Switch to **Log** to compare changes in percentage terms: on a log scale a doubling looks the same in 2013 and in 2022, so quieter years are no longer flattened by the 2022 gas crisis.

```{python}
#| label: long-chart
# Weekly averages of the daily EUR and USD prices; weeks with fewer than 5 days of data are left out.
wk = d[["ptf_eur_mean", "ptf_usd_mean"]].resample("W-MON", label="left", closed="left")
wk = wk.mean().where(wk.count() >= 5)
cur = {"EUR": ("ptf_eur_mean", "EUR/MWh"), "USD": ("ptf_usd_mean", "USD/MWh")}

fig2 = cs.figure(None, "Weekly average PTF (EUR/MWh)", height=420)
for name, (col, unit) in cur.items():
    cs.add_line(fig2, wk.index, wk[col], "prices", "ptf", name=f"PTF in {name}", unit=f" {unit}",
                hover_fmt=",.1f", end_label=False)
    fig2.data[-1].update(visible=(name == "EUR"), line=dict(width=1.5))
fig2.update_layout(
    showlegend=False,
    margin=dict(t=48),
    updatemenus=[
        dict(type="buttons", direction="right", active=0, x=0, y=1.03, xanchor="left", yanchor="bottom",
             buttons=[dict(label=k, method="update",
                           args=[{"visible": [j == i for j in range(len(cur))]},
                                 {"yaxis.title.text": f"Weekly average PTF ({cur[k][1]})", "yaxis.autorange": True}])
                      for i, k in enumerate(cur)]),
        dict(type="buttons", direction="right", active=0, x=0.2, y=1.03, xanchor="left", yanchor="bottom",
             buttons=[dict(label="Linear", method="relayout",
                           args=[{"yaxis.type": "linear", "yaxis.autorange": True, "yaxis.tickvals": None}]),
                      dict(label="Log", method="relayout",
                           args=[{"yaxis.type": "log", "yaxis.autorange": True,
                                  "yaxis.tickvals": [5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500]}])]),
    ],
)
fig2.update_yaxes(autorange=True, rangemode="tozero")
fig2.update_xaxes(rangeselector=dict(buttons=[dict(count=2, label="2Y", step="year", stepmode="backward"),
                                              dict(count=5, label="5Y", step="year", stepmode="backward"),
                                              dict(step="all", label="All")],
                                     x=1, xanchor="right", y=1.03, yanchor="bottom"))
cs.style_controls(fig2)
cs.show(fig2)
```

## Yearly averages

```{python}
#| label: yearly-table
y = m.copy()
y["year"] = y.index.year
h = y["hours_with_price"]
agg = pd.DataFrame({
    "PTF (TL/MWh)": (y["ptf_mean"] * h).groupby(y["year"]).sum() / h.groupby(y["year"]).sum(),
    "PTF (EUR/MWh)": (y["ptf_eur_mean"] * h).groupby(y["year"]).sum() / h.where(y["ptf_eur_mean"].notna()).groupby(y["year"]).sum(),
    "PTF (USD/MWh)": (y["ptf_usd_mean"] * h).groupby(y["year"]).sum() / h.where(y["ptf_usd_mean"].notna()).groupby(y["year"]).sum(),
    "SMF (TL/MWh)": (y["smf_mean"] * h).groupby(y["year"]).sum() / h.where(y["smf_mean"].notna()).groupby(y["year"]).sum(),
    "AOF (TL/MWh)": (y["aof_mean"] * h).groupby(y["year"]).sum() / h.where(y["aof_mean"].notna()).groupby(y["year"]).sum(),
    "Hours system short": (y["deficit_share"] * h).groupby(y["year"]).sum() / h.where(y["deficit_share"].notna()).groupby(y["year"]).sum(),
})
agg = agg.sort_index(ascending=False)
partial = {agg.index.max(): f"{agg.index.max()} (to {last:%d %b})", agg.index.min(): f"{agg.index.min()} (from Nov)"}
agg.index = [partial.get(i, str(i)) for i in agg.index]
out = agg.copy()
for c in ["PTF (TL/MWh)", "SMF (TL/MWh)", "AOF (TL/MWh)"]:
    out[c] = agg[c].map(lambda v: fmt(v))
for c in ["PTF (EUR/MWh)", "PTF (USD/MWh)"]:
    out[c] = agg[c].map(lambda v: fmt(v, 1))
out["Hours system short"] = agg["Hours system short"].map(lambda v: "–" if pd.isna(v) else f"{v:.0%}")
Markdown(out.to_markdown(disable_numparse=True, colalign=["left"] + ["right"] * len(out.columns)))
```

Yearly figures are simple averages of hourly prices: every hour counts the same. SMF starts in April 2014 on the transparency platform, AOF in July 2015 when the intraday market opened. "Hours system short" is the share of hours in which the system needed extra energy (Enerji Açığı), so balancing instructions were mostly to increase output.

### Download the data

```{python}
#| label: downloads
cols = {"ptf_mean": "ptf_try_mwh", "ptf_cons_weighted": "ptf_consumption_weighted_try_mwh",
        "ptf_min": "ptf_min_try_mwh", "ptf_max": "ptf_max_try_mwh", "ptf_eur_mean": "ptf_eur_mwh",
        "ptf_usd_mean": "ptf_usd_mwh", "smf_mean": "smf_try_mwh", "aof_mean": "aof_try_mwh",
        "deficit_share": "share_hours_system_short", "surplus_share": "share_hours_system_long"}
yearly = agg.copy()
yearly.index = [int(str(i)[:4]) for i in yearly.index]
yearly = yearly.rename_axis("year").reset_index().rename(columns={
    "PTF (TL/MWh)": "ptf_try_mwh", "PTF (EUR/MWh)": "ptf_eur_mwh", "PTF (USD/MWh)": "ptf_usd_mwh",
    "SMF (TL/MWh)": "smf_try_mwh", "AOF (TL/MWh)": "aof_try_mwh", "Hours system short": "share_hours_system_short"}).round(4)
monthly_dl = m[list(cols)].rename(columns=cols).round(4)
monthly_dl.index = monthly_dl.index.strftime("%Y-%m")
daily_dl = d[list(cols)].rename(columns=cols).round(4)
daily_dl.index = daily_dl.index.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
stamp = f"{last:%Y%m%d}"
HTML(
    cs.download_link(yearly, f"trpowerlab_prices_yearly_{stamp}.csv", "Yearly (CSV)")
    + cs.download_link(monthly_dl.rename_axis("month").reset_index(), f"trpowerlab_prices_monthly_{stamp}.csv", "Monthly (CSV)")
    + cs.download_link(daily_dl.rename_axis("date").reset_index(), f"trpowerlab_prices_daily_{stamp}.csv", "Daily (CSV)")
)
```

Prices are averages of EPİAŞ hourly data, in Turkish lira, euros or US dollars per MWh; shares are fractions of hours (0.65 = 65%). Please credit *TR Power Lab, based on EPİAŞ Şeffaflık Platformu data*. The averages are ours under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); the underlying data belong to EPİAŞ.

## Where electricity is traded

Electricity changes hands in three places: bilateral contracts (İA) agreed directly between companies, the day-ahead market (GÖP) run by EPİAŞ, and the intraday market (GİP), where positions are adjusted up to shortly before delivery. Bilateral volume counts every contract, including resales between traders, so traded volume is larger than consumption. Volumes are published from December 2017.

```{python}
#| label: market-chart
mk = m.loc[VOL_FROM:, ["bilateral_mwh", "gop_mwh", "idm_mwh", "consumption_mwh", "hours_with_price"]]
mk = mk[mk["hours_with_price"] >= mk.index.days_in_month * 24 - 1]       # full months only
keys = [("bilateral", "bilateral_mwh"), ("gop", "gop_mwh"), ("gip", "idm_mwh")]
figm = cs.figure(None, "TWh per month", height=440)
for key, col in keys:
    cs.add_area(figm, mk.index, mk[col] / 1e6, "markets", key, unit=" TWh", hover_fmt=",.1f")
twh_hover = [t.hovertemplate for t in figm.data]
pct_hover = [f"%{{y:.1f}}%<extra>{t.name}</extra>" for t in figm.data]
figm.update_layout(
    margin=dict(t=48), legend=dict(traceorder="reversed"),
    updatemenus=[dict(type="buttons", direction="right", active=0, x=0, y=1.03, xanchor="left", yanchor="bottom",
                      buttons=[dict(label="TWh", method="update",
                                    args=[{"groupnorm": [""] * 3, "hovertemplate": twh_hover},
                                          {"yaxis.title.text": "TWh per month", "yaxis.ticksuffix": ""}]),
                               dict(label="Share", method="update",
                                    args=[{"groupnorm": ["percent"] * 3, "hovertemplate": pct_hover},
                                          {"yaxis.title.text": "Share of traded volume", "yaxis.ticksuffix": "%"}])])],
)
cs.style_controls(figm)
cs.show(figm)
```

```{python}
#| label: market-table
vy = m.loc[VOL_FROM:, ["bilateral_mwh", "gop_mwh", "idm_mwh", "consumption_mwh"]]
vy = vy.groupby(vy.index.year).sum(min_count=1) / 1e6
traded = vy[["bilateral_mwh", "gop_mwh", "idm_mwh"]].sum(axis=1)
vt = pd.DataFrame({
    "Bilateral (TWh)": vy["bilateral_mwh"].map(lambda v: fmt(v, 1)),
    "GÖP (TWh)": vy["gop_mwh"].map(lambda v: fmt(v, 1)),
    "GİP (TWh)": vy["idm_mwh"].map(lambda v: fmt(v, 1)),
    "Bilateral share": (vy["bilateral_mwh"] / traded).map(lambda v: f"{v:.0%}"),
    "GÖP share": (vy["gop_mwh"] / traded).map(lambda v: f"{v:.0%}"),
    "GİP share": (vy["idm_mwh"] / traded).map(lambda v: f"{v:.1%}"),
    "Traded ÷ consumption": (traded / vy["consumption_mwh"]).map(lambda v: f"{v:.2f}×"),
}).sort_index(ascending=False)
vt.index = [f"{y} (to {last:%d %b})" if y == last.year else (f"{y} (Dec only)" if y == 2017 else str(y)) for y in vt.index]
Markdown(vt.to_markdown(disable_numparse=True, colalign=["left"] + ["right"] * len(vt.columns)))
```

The day-ahead market is where the reference price is set, but most electricity is sold through bilateral contracts. The intraday market is small: a few percent of traded volume, used to correct positions as forecasts change.

```{python}
#| label: market-downloads
vcols = {"bilateral_mwh": "bilateral_mwh", "gop_mwh": "gop_matched_mwh", "idm_mwh": "gip_matched_mwh",
         "bilateral_share": "bilateral_share", "gop_share": "gop_share", "idm_share": "gip_share",
         "consumption_mwh": "consumption_reported_mwh"}
mv = m.loc[VOL_FROM:, list(vcols)].rename(columns=vcols).round(4)
mv.index = mv.index.strftime("%Y-%m")
dv = d.loc[VOL_FROM:, list(vcols)].rename(columns=vcols).round(4)
dv.index = dv.index.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
yv = vy.rename(columns={"bilateral_mwh": "bilateral_twh", "gop_mwh": "gop_matched_twh", "idm_mwh": "gip_matched_twh",
                        "consumption_mwh": "consumption_reported_twh"}).round(3)
HTML(
    cs.download_link(yv.rename_axis("year").reset_index(), f"trpowerlab_market_volumes_yearly_{stamp}.csv", "Yearly volumes (CSV)")
    + cs.download_link(mv.rename_axis("month").reset_index(), f"trpowerlab_market_volumes_monthly_{stamp}.csv", "Monthly volumes (CSV)")
    + cs.download_link(dv.rename_axis("date").reset_index(), f"trpowerlab_market_volumes_daily_{stamp}.csv", "Daily volumes (CSV)")
)
```

## Notes

- **Source:** EPİAŞ Şeffaflık Platformu, through the open source [eptr2](https://github.com/Tideseed/eptr2) package. Data to `{python} f"{last:%d %B %Y}"`.
- **Price caps:** PTF and SMF are limited by a maximum settlement price set by EPDK. The cap changed several times since 2022; monthly maximum prices sit on the cap in many months.
- **Gaps:** a few hours on old daylight saving days are missing in the source data and are left out, not filled.
- See the [methodology](../../methodology.qmd) for definitions and the data quality notes.
